descriptionHtml:
Approach · TC-06 Admission Status Toggle · S10 Midnight edges on the server clock: set at 23:59, set at 00:01, a future-stamped day, list left open across midnight

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U5 New Admission and Consult both roll to Follow-up on the next calendar day without the physician touching them; a status set today stays today (UAT TC-06; TFA-92584 AC 4)
  • U6 The day roll uses server time, not the device clock: a device with a wrong date, no clock set or another time zone shows the same badge and the same pre-selected template as any other device, and nev … (UAT TC-06; UAT 3.8; TFA-92584 AC 8)

Test design technique: Boundary values (boundary) — Sit right on the edge of the rule (exactly on time / a minute late, empty, longest, most) and see on which side the behavior changes.

Given Hospital patient and resident; physician sets New Admission at 23:59 and Consult at 00:01 (server day, Q1 time zone); one row stamped encTypeDay = server day + 1 (what a device whose clock is ahead writes on main)

When Move the server clock to 00:00:30 and to 23:59 of the same day, then past the next midnight; keep one list open across midnight and re-open the other

Then 23:59 status reads Follow-up from 00:00 on; 00:01 status stays all day and rolls at the next midnight; the future-stamped row reads Follow-up from the next server midnight, not a day later; the open list updates without a reload; every device agrees

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): UAT TC-06 + 3.8. Which midnight counts is Q1; the list update delay is not specified (lifecycle re-runs every 10 min). Day roll on the device clock is known: TFA-92584 AC 8

Where it ran: dev; test method TIME · Time / aging (clock moved); lane planned in the matrix: browser agent (blocked)

S10 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-06.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: dev — dev deployment, build e02167f (Deploy Convex, 2026-10-12T18:24:27Z); account and address are not written into the report; run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev.

Test method: TIME · Time / aging (clock moved); secondary: CODEREVIEW · Code review — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on local (23:59/00:01 and list-open-across-midnight cells) / dev (future-stamped encTypeDay cell through seed and applyLifecycle); Source: dev.
